title: statusline r5 UX+A11y: no non-interactive accept path
description: Round 5. Lenses: ux+accessibility merged (validators: DR, UX). Owner: SO session. Defect: non-interactive is decline-only; automation and motor-limited operators have no tool-driven accept (a yes-style flag is the crosslink/Thermite CLI convention, and divergence carries no stated reason per the engineering-conventions ruling); interactive prompt's timeout conduct unstated. Citations verified: contract:162, :163, :187. Proposed: resolved-candidate (explicit accept flag = confirmed interactive run).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: explicit accept flag contracted — non-interactive accept installs the default wiring exactly as a confirmed interactive run (upstream CLI convention followed, motor/automation path provided); criterion drives it against the statusLine-absent fixture. Revision: Install bullet + criterion.
